header.userPrompt: plan and bump the scala binding from r185 to r186, notice that threejs javascript code tag versions are checkouted in "submodules" folder.

findings.title: Formatting-only hunks in files the r186 bump does not touch are still present

reason.text: Environmental. I already restored these files and hunks to d607426 twice, and both times `sbt Test/compile` passed with a clean diff. They keep coming back because `.orca/settings.properties` sets `format = sbt scalafmtAll`, and that gate runs across the whole repo after every fix round. It reformats these files, which were already out of format at d607426. Reverting them again would just be undone by the next format run. Two ways to end the loop: limit or turn off the format gate (for example, apply repo-wide formatting in a separate commit first), or accept the formatter output.
